---
title: Essential pathway
order: 20
---

The essential pathway is recommended for everyone working on research technical professional projects but can be particularly useful for new starters.

Starting from the [DIRECT Framework](https://directframework.com/) we have considered what skills could be minimal set of skills to develop and hone as a part of any research technical professional project.

These are focussed on the following areas:

 - Communication
 - Time management
 - Software Engineering
 - Domain specific knowledge

From the DIRECT skills framework this translates to:

 - Stakeholder and user engagement
 - Task management
 - Code review
 - *Something specific to the technology stack on your project*
